metadata.title: Test Hardening, Repo Polish, and the Pace-Ratio Sweep

story.iWant: to clone the repo and reproduce every figure and number without asking anyone
story.soThat: the note's claims are auditable by a stranger
story.tasks: - Pace-ratio sweep (AC: 1) - Summary field (AC: 2) - Guard and Makefile (AC: 3, 4) - Coverage (AC: 5) - Docs and pins (AC: 6–9) - Close out (AC: 10)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–10. Guard semantics (warn on code hash, fail on source hash) are normative.

docs.doc: Why warn; what the README is for.

dependencies.python: No new dependencies (no hypothesis); pytest-cov already present.

story-context.constraints: - No kernel/ or protocol/ behaviour changes; PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1; every scenario hash unchanged. - summary.json gains one key; the determinism fixtures are updated once with the diff in the Debug Log. - README body has no story or ADR numbers. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: sha256 hex over sorted src/depeg_sim/**/*.py contents

tests.standards: pytest + pytest-cov; seeded Generator for random sequences; coverage threshold asserted in CI for the two packages.
